sources: Tradewinds Oct 30, citing maritime security firm Vanguard Tech and S&P Global Seaweb database
fault_line: A named ship with a named owner and operator vs an anonymous UKMTO incident number -- attribution makes the shipping war concrete, but the name still rests on trade-press sourcing, not an official report.

sections.what_happened: The vessel hit by a small boat that attached two explosive devices to its port-side hull on Thursday (UKMTO 187-26) is identified as the 159,100-dwt suezmax Louise 1 (built 2004), Panama-based owner Aquarius Maritime Ventures, UAE-based operator PRY Shipping per S&P Global Seaweb. The engine-room fire was extinguished and the vessel continued to its next port of call. Tradewinds counts this as the 35th confirmed attack on a ship within a single month and says Iran or Tehran-aligned actors hit 34 oceangoing commercial ships between Sep 29 and Oct 29. COUNT NOTE: this differs from Washington Institute researcher Noam Raydan's count of 30 Iranian attacks on shipping since Oct 1 (via SOFX, also undeclared) -- different windows and methods; do NOT merge into one number. VESSEL-NAME CAVEAT: Tradewinds, Vanguard Tech and S&P Seaweb carry NO declared tier in the source registry, so the name still counts 0 declared families and is reported here WITH ATTRIBUTION ONLY -- UKMTO has not itself named the vessel in any retrieved report.
sections.what_verified: Attack itself: UKMTO (T1) confirmed (0800-01). Vessel identity: Tradewinds + Vanguard Tech + S&P Seaweb, all undeclared tier -- attribution strengthened vs the 1300-07 RegionAlert lead, but still 0 declared families for the name.
sections.what_disputed: No declared-tier source or UKMTO statement names the vessel; attack-count totals differ across counters (Tradewinds 34 in Sep 29-Oct 29 vs Raydan 30 since Oct 1). UKMTO confirmed the attack mechanism (small boat, two devices) but not the vessel name.
sections.why_matters: Name the ship, name the tactic (first small-boat hull-device attack on a ship underway in this area, per Tradewinds) -- with on-screen attribution to Tradewinds/Vanguard, never as a UKMTO confirmation.
